plans.name: due cards: earliest due first, equal due by id
plans.note: b and a have the same history, so the same due: id order decides; c is due earlier

plans.name: new cards: createdAt order, equal createdAt by id
plans.note: never-reviewed cards in the order added (createdAt, then id)

plans.name: new cards by frequency rank (orderNew)
plans.note: with a new-card order, ranked cards first by rank, unranked after them in the order added

plans.name: due before new, each up to its limit
plans.note: reviewLimit 1 and newLimit 1: one due card, then one new card; the reserve is every new item the daily limits allow past the session cap (session-queue.json), real cards included

plans.name: a reverse card needs a session deck that switches reverse on
plans.note: r1 sits in a deck without the switch and is not queued; r2 sits in d2, which enables reverse

plans.name: a kind the word skips is never queued or planned
plans.note: v1 skips writing: its writing card stays out and no writing companion is planned; v2 gets one

plans.name: a sibling answered today buries the opt-in cards of the word
plans.note: v1 was answered today: its reverse card r1 is buried until the next learner day, and no reverse companion is planned for it

plans.name: companions round-robin over the kinds within the budget
plans.note: budget 3 over two words: sentence, writing, tone of the oldest word first (one per kind per round), the rest is the reserve

plans.name: new real cards use the budget before companions
plans.note: newLimit 2 with one new vocab card leaves one companion slot

plans.name: reverse is preferred over cloze, at most one opt-in per word
plans.note: a word gets a reverse companion; a word that already has a reverse card gets cloze instead

plans.name: a word with a queued real card gets no opt-in companion
plans.note: v1 is due today, so it is excluded from opt-in planning; v2 is not and gets its reverse companion

plans.name: opt-in companions only from decks of the session that enable them
plans.note: v2 is in d2 (reverse on) but d2 is not a session deck

plans.name: writing is not planned for a snapshot without Han characters
plans.note: a written snapshot without a Han character can never be written; without a snapshot the runner decides when shown

plans.name: tone is a session kind only in a Chinese workspace
plans.note: in a Japanese workspace tone cards and tone companions are left out

plans.name: offline: real cards only
plans.note: offline no companion is planned (a companion is created by a row write on its first grade)

plans.name: a vacation day has an empty session
plans.note: today is inside a vacation run: nothing is due and nothing new is shown

plans.name: newLimit 0: no new cards, no companions, backfill 30
plans.note: backfillLimit = max(30, 2 * newLimit)

plans.name: newLimit 25: backfill 50
plans.note: backfillLimit = max(30, 2 * newLimit)

plans.name: a companion remembered ineligible is never planned
plans.note: skip holds kind:entryId of companions found ineligible earlier

plans.name: a deck daily new limit caps new cards and companions
plans.note: deck d1 allows 1 new card a day: one new item from d1, the rest of d1 is neither queued nor reserved

plans.name: a character card unlocks writing the learner day after its first review
plans.note: character cards get no sentence or tone companion; writing only after the learner day of the first review (Tokyo days here)

plans.name: only cards of the session decks and kinds
plans.note: cards outside deckIds or of a kind not selected stay out

steps.name: dropping a companion backfills from the reserve
steps.note: a dropped virtual item frees its slot: the first reserve item is appended and backfillLeft decreases; dropping a real card frees nothing; an unknown id changes nothing

steps.name: backfill stops at backfillLeft
steps.note: with backfillLeft exhausted a dropped companion is not replaced; the reserve holds at most backfillLeft items, so it is empty by then

steps.name: answering a word buries its later opt-in items
steps.note: answering vocab v1 removes the later real reverse card r1 of word 1 (a real card frees nothing); answering the virtual reverse item of word 2 removes the later sentence item of word 2 (virtual: the first reserve item takes its slot)

eligible.name: writing needs a Han character with stroke data
eligible.note: writing needs a Han character with stroke data

eligible.name: writing of a character without glosses
eligible.note: writing of a character without glosses

eligible.name: tone in a Chinese workspace with a pinyin reading
eligible.note: tone in a Chinese workspace with a pinyin reading

eligible.name: tone with only a numbered pinyin reading
eligible.note: tone with only a numbered pinyin reading

eligible.name: reverse needs a word with a gloss
eligible.note: reverse needs a word with a gloss

eligible.name: reverse of a word without glosses
eligible.note: reverse of a word without glosses

eligible.name: cloze needs an eligible cloze sentence
eligible.note: cloze needs an eligible cloze sentence
